cartographic_sources.survey: IGN BD TOPO V3 piste_d_aerodrome / batiment, queried 2026-10-06; complete 2699-building pagination
cartographic_sources.notes: All three surveyed pavement objects and their islands preserved. Airport building footprints filtered at the airside boundary. Runway 2300 x 45 m anchored to published physical ends, with landing thresholds displaced approximately 300/170 m. Runway paint schematic. APDC stand names and relative positions registered to the IGN apron (cartographic positions, no published stand coordinates). No yellow guidance lines; wig-wags are not represented as red stop bars.
